strengths: PIT-clean: regime_engine_daily v2.0 with 9-axis FRED + t-1 lag (NOT old invalidated MRS)
OOS retention 59.3% and stable alpha trend (1.04 ratio)
weaknesses: MDD 36% exceeds 25% target — tighter MRS 12/25 actually WORSE than base 34.3% (net -1.7%)
CAGR 12.94% below 16% target; Sharpe 0.848 below 2.0 target
Calmar 0.359 very weak — insufficient return per unit drawdown
BM correlation 0.628 questions diversifier value — may be redundant with market exposure
FF5 defense not verified — risk of value factor loading explaining all returns
summary.recommendation: Grade B confirmed. Keep for portfolio gap analysis but NOT a production candidate. The C1_MRS1225 mutation (tighter MRS 12→25) failed its thesis — MDD worsened from 34.3% to 36.0%. Tighter MRS triggers more frequent de-risking, reducing CAGR without improving drawdown protection (likely whipsawed during volatile non-crisis periods). Base STR_1333 with MRS 15/30 is marginally better. Value+ESBR synergy concept is sound but overlay tuning needs crisis-specific calibration, not threshold tightening.
